The receipt decision this card targets does not need a new test: storing the served probabilities with each decision is cheap and is already implied by B1 and E-20260927-02-r2 (the djev note itself supports B1). The djev arm compares a different model (Bespoke-Nimble-9B, 87.0 vs 93.2 on Nimble's set, different measurers), so determinism and accuracy are confounded, and it needs an H100. The part that matters for our gates, the hosted-Jev flip rate at each threshold, is measured as a by-product in E-20260929-02. Re-raise it if a design proposes re-executing gate decisions instead of storing them.
